description:
Get the full financial assistance (charity care) policy we hold for one hospital or health center, with source URLs, short quotes, and last-checked date.
Use it when the patient asks what the policy says, or to get the source behind a policy fact.
Takes the facility id from find_facilities (hospital CCN, slug, or health center id).
Returns the data tier (verified, IRS filing with tax year, state program, or legal baseline only), the thresholds used, the policy with sources, IRS filing details, and state programs. Null fields mean the value is not known.

facility_id.description: Hospital CCN (for example "220071"), facility slug, or health center org id.

name: get_policy
title: Get a facility's financial assistance policy
